\section{Goblin Infantry}

\textbf{Size:} Small \\
\textbf{Models:} 1x Elite Goblin Infantry, 2x Elite Goblin Infantry, 1x Goblin Infantry \\
\textbf{Type:} Bio, Infantry, Walking \\
\textbf{Points:} 28 \\
\textbf{Shaken:} slow [-, -, Flee] / Can't use weapons

\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{\hyperref[rule-special-to-hit]{To Hit}}: Take Cover[Sneak][-2]
\item \textbf{\hyperref[rule-special-fire-order]{Fire Order}}: You may either fire a regular arrow, a special arrow (arrow with limited ammo) or use one thrown weapon with each fire order.
\item \textbf{\hyperref[rule-special-evasion]{Evasion}}: [4+]
\item \textbf{\hyperref[rule-special-resistance]{Resistance}}: Psychic[1]. As long as at least one elite model is alive
\item \textbf{\hyperref[rule-special-pre-assault-retreat]{Pre-Assault Retreat}}: [6+]. Improved by 1 per elite in unit
\end{itemize}


\noindent\textbf{Damage Table: Regular}

\begin{tabular}{ll}
0-5 & Kill 1 model \\
6-7 & Kill 1 model, Psychic damage[d6] \\
8+ & Unit destroyed \\
\end{tabular}
\begin{itemize}
\item If one model is killed remove half of the +1 future damage tokens and if killed by bleeding/poison, remove that bleeding/poison token
\end{itemize}
\vspace{1ex}

\noindent\textbf{Damage Table: Psychic}

\begin{tabular}{ll}
4+ & shaken \\
\end{tabular}
\vspace{1ex}

\section{Heavy Carrier}

% With art, the stat block and the image sit side by side; without it, the
% stat block runs full width. Everything below resumes full width either way.

\textbf{Size:} Large \\
\textbf{Models:} 1x Heavy Carrier \\
\textbf{Type:} Mechanical, Vehicle, Tracked \\
\textbf{Armor:} 10, 8, 6, 4 \\
\textbf{Points:} 96 \\
\textbf{Shaken:} still [-, -, -] / Can't use weapons

\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{\hyperref[rule-special-transport]{Transport}}: May transport up to 1 Goblin infantry. Deploy order is Deploy(range=1). May deploy directly into assault. If Heavy Carrier enters an assault, you may optionally deploy the infantry to join the assault
\item \textbf{\hyperref[rule-special-forward-position]{Forward Position}}: [1]
\item \textbf{\hyperref[rule-special-fire-order]{Fire Order}}: Fire and load all weapons simultaneously, with identical ammo usage for all weapons
\end{itemize}


\noindent\textbf{Damage Table: Regular}

\begin{tabular}{ll}
1-3 & +1 to future damage \\
4 & As 1-3 , shaken \\
5-8 & As 4, d6 critical damage \\
9 & Unit destroyed \\
\end{tabular}
\vspace{1ex}

\noindent\textbf{Damage Table: Critical}

\begin{tabular}{ll}
1 & 1d4 damage to all transported units \\
2 & Forced Deploy (empty hexes only) \\
3 & +1 to be hit, -1 to hit \\
4 & Cannot rotate \\
5 & Unit cannot move \\
6 & Fire \\
\end{tabular}
\vspace{1ex}

\noindent\textbf{Damage Table: Crew}

\begin{tabular}{ll}
4-5 & Crippled Crew, if already shaken double initial Crew damage \\
6-7 & As 4-5, shaken \\
8-11 & As 6-7, +3 to future Crew damage \\
12 & Unit destroyed \\
\end{tabular}
\vspace{1ex}

\section{Rules Reference}


\phantomsection\label{rule-damage-type-acid}%
\noindent\textbf{Acid (damage type)} --- \textit{Rule text pending.}\begin{itemize}
\item \textit{See also:} \hyperref[rule-token-minor-acid]{Minor Acid (token)}
\end{itemize}


\phantomsection\label{rule-token-acid}%
\noindent\textbf{Acid (token)} --- Roll a d8 on the following damage table:

1. Downgrade from acid to minor acid.
2. +1 to future damage
3. As 2, and if unit has armor, it is reduced by 1 (all directions)
4. As 3, and place a poison cloud [4] at hex, and all units in this hex gets a minor acid token.
5. As 4, and in addition all units within range=2 gets a minor acid token
6. As 5, and unit gains a terror token.
7. As 6 and unit is set on fire.
8. Roll three times on this table.,
\begin{itemize}
\item \textit{Phases:} Agony 0
\item \textit{Removed:} Downgraded as part of effect
\end{itemize}


\phantomsection\label{rule-token-aim}%
\noindent\textbf{Aim (token)} --- Get +2 to hit an enemy. Only valid for units in line of sight of the hex where the aim was given. Last for only 1 round.\begin{itemize}
\item \textit{Phases:} Gunnery 1, Gunnery 2
\item \textit{Removed:} Either remove all aim tokens when you fire, or remove one each aftermath phase. Also remove all of them if you enter an assault (regardless of whether you win or not)
\item \textit{To hit:} +2
\item \textit{To be hit:} 0
\end{itemize}


\phantomsection\label{rule-special-ammo}%
\noindent\textbf{Ammo (special)} --- Describes how a weapon is loaded and how its ammo is tracked.\begin{itemize}
\item \textit{See also:} Limited Ammo (special)
\end{itemize}


\phantomsection\label{rule-ability-bad-shot}%
\noindent\textbf{Bad Shot (ability)}\begin{itemize}
\item \textit{To hit:} -1
\item \textit{To be hit:} 0
\end{itemize}


\phantomsection\label{rule-special-cunning-assault}%
\noindent\textbf{Cunning Assault (special)} --- For each \{N\} assault successes assigned to one mechanical unit in assault, add +1 to all future damage tokens. If you manage to inflict two or more +1 to future damage this way, the enemy is shaken. Multiple hits from multiple models with same ability stack.\begin{itemize}
\item \textit{See also:} Cunning Assault Defense (special)
\end{itemize}


\phantomsection\label{rule-special-cunning-deflection}%
\noindent\textbf{Cunning Deflection (special)} --- \textit{Rule text pending.}\begin{itemize}
\item \textit{See also:} \hyperref[rule-special-cunning-assault]{Cunning Assault (special)}, Cunning Assault Defense (special)
\end{itemize}


\phantomsection\label{rule-ability-enhanced-accuracy}%
\noindent\textbf{Enhanced Accuracy (ability)}\begin{itemize}
\item \textit{To hit:} +1
\item \textit{To be hit:} 0
\end{itemize}


\phantomsection\label{rule-special-evasion}%
\noindent\textbf{Evasion (special)} --- Roll a die per area of effect damage. Ignore the damage at \{N\}+

\phantomsection\label{rule-special-fire-order}%
\noindent\textbf{Fire Order (special)} --- \textit{Rule text pending.}

\phantomsection\label{rule-special-forward-position}%
\noindent\textbf{Forward Position (special)} --- At setup this unit may setup upt to \{N\} hexes away from normal setup area.

\phantomsection\label{rule-alias-imprecise-weapon}%
\noindent\textbf{Imprecise Weapon} --- see \hyperref[rule-special-to-hit]{To Hit (special)}

\phantomsection\label{rule-token-minor-acid}%
\noindent\textbf{Minor Acid (token)} --- Role a die, at 3+, unit gets +1 on future damage. Otherwise, remove minor acid\begin{itemize}
\item \textit{Phases:} Agony 1
\item \textit{Removed:} Only as part of effect
\end{itemize}


\phantomsection\label{rule-special-multiple-shots}%
\noindent\textbf{Multiple Shots (special)} --- \textit{Rule text pending.}\begin{itemize}
\item \textit{See also:} Burst (special)
\end{itemize}


\phantomsection\label{rule-damage-type-poison}%
\noindent\textbf{Poison (damage type)} --- \textit{Rule text pending.}\begin{itemize}
\item \textit{See also:} \hyperref[rule-token-poison]{Poison (token)}
\end{itemize}


\phantomsection\label{rule-token-poison}%
\noindent\textbf{Poison (token)} --- Roll a d\{N\}.

- Ignore armor and regular damage resistances
- Reduce damage by poison resistances of target
- Apply bonus to damage based on the number +future damage tokens
- Apply damage to the regular damage table.
- If poison killed a model, remove poison.

If poison did not kill a model, downgrade poison one step\begin{itemize}
\item \textit{Phases:} Agony 3
\item \textit{See also:} \hyperref[rule-special-resistance]{Resistance (special)}
\end{itemize}


\phantomsection\label{rule-special-pre-assault-retreat}%
\noindent\textbf{Pre-Assault Retreat (special)} --- In pre-assault phase you may roll a die. At N+ you may retreat before the assaults starts. Treat this as a regular reatreat but give or take no assault damage. This ability may only be used if the hex retreating into neither becomes overcrowded, is an illegal hex or contain enemies.\begin{itemize}
\item \textit{See also:} Retreat (special)
\end{itemize}


\phantomsection\label{rule-damage-type-psychic}%
\noindent\textbf{Psychic (damage type)} --- \textit{Rule text pending.}

\phantomsection\label{rule-special-range-extra-damage}%
\noindent\textbf{Range Extra Damage (special)} --- The target gets one \{version\}.\begin{itemize}
\item \textit{See also:} Assault Extra Damage (special), \hyperref[rule-special-range-gear-disruption]{Range Gear Disruption (special)}
\end{itemize}


\phantomsection\label{rule-special-range-gear-disruption}%
\noindent\textbf{Range Gear Disruption (special)} --- Only applies when target is a drone. The drone gets one shaken token per roll of \{N\}+.\begin{itemize}
\item \textit{See also:} Assault Gear Disruption (special)
\end{itemize}


\phantomsection\label{rule-special-resistance}%
\noindent\textbf{Resistance (special)} --- Gives improved resilience versus \{version\} damage

\phantomsection\label{rule-token-shaken}%
\noindent\textbf{Shaken (token)} --- While shaken set unit speed to the specified speed, and how a unit behaves is described by each unit. Disregard the original orders and replace them with the order(s) described by the unit\begin{itemize}
\item \textit{Phases:} Gunnery 1, Movement 1, Movement 2, Movement 3, Gunnery 2
\item \textit{Removed:} Remove one each aftermath phase. Can also be removed by appropriate repair or healing abilities
\item \textit{See also:} Heal (special), Repair (special)
\end{itemize}


\phantomsection\label{rule-speed-sneak}%
\noindent\textbf{Sneak (speed)}\begin{itemize}
\item \textit{To hit:} +1
\item \textit{To be hit:} 0
\end{itemize}


\phantomsection\label{rule-ability-take-cover}%
\noindent\textbf{Take Cover (ability)} --- Applies when the unit is in the given speed\begin{itemize}
\item \textit{To hit:} 0
\item \textit{To be hit:} +N
\end{itemize}


\phantomsection\label{rule-ability-thrown-weapons}%
\noindent\textbf{Thrown Weapons (ability)} --- Applies to thrown weapons only\begin{itemize}
\item \textit{To hit:} +N
\item \textit{To be hit:} 0
\end{itemize}


\phantomsection\label{rule-special-to-hit}%
\noindent\textbf{To Hit (special)} --- Shifts the to-hit and to-be-hit rolls by \{ability\}.

\phantomsection\label{rule-special-transport}%
\noindent\textbf{Transport (special)} --- \textit{Rule text pending.}\end{document}
